[SWS_CORE_10600] Semantics of ara::core::Result
⌈
The type ara::-
core::Result shall provide a means to handle both return values and errors from
synchronous function calls in an exception-less way, by providing an encapsulated
return type which may be either:
• a value V, where V may be any C++ type; or
• an error E, where E may be any C++ type; default is ara::core::ErrorCode.
⌋
